statements.text: Ramsdens is a trading name of Ramsdens Financial Limited (Ramsdens). Ramsdens is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) for consumer credit and as an authorised payments institution. Ramsdens can be found on the Financial Services Register with our firm reference number (FRN) 703463, limited to the provision of pawnbroking and credit brokerage, and FRN 1004451, for authorised payments. The FCA do not regulate the other services offered by Ramsdens. Ramsdens Financial Limited is registered in England and Wales. Registration Number: 03045495. Registered Office: Unit 16 Falcon Court, Preston Farm Industrial Estate, Stockton on Tees, TS18 3TU.
